committee.sub: Morning brief · Saturday 7 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Weekly ad spend rose to A$152.68 from A$129.98 while clicks grew to 19 from 16, pushing CPC to A$8.04; the A$600 landing page test credit is now fully spent (creditRemainingExGst A$0) after 92 raw paid clicks.

No external Google Ads changes were logged in the last 24 hours or 7 days, so the test figures are not contaminated; Search Console data only runs through 4 Nov (a two-day lag) with 2 clicks from 231 impressions, and the 74.5% rank-lost share still dwarfs the 18.2% budget-lost share, though budget stays fixed for now.

On the frozen landing page (clicks long past 25), ask_cta_click sits at 18 since the test started versus review_cta_click at 0: the shallow question form is getting used but nobody has booked the deeper 60 minute review yet.

Two generate_lead events have fired on the landing page test, matching leads.last7=2 and formStartsLast7=2: these are unverified enquiry candidates still needing grading against the real business, repeatable process and named system rule.

actions.text: Total raw paid clicks have reached 92, past the 75-click check: review the test log now, if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries the red flag fires. The page stays frozen (headline, offer, CTAs) since click 25.
The A$600 test credit is now at A$0: apply the pause rule, keep paid search running only if cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or under and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review.
generate_lead has fired twice since the test began: check the Formspree and Cal.com emails for source and grade each in the test log against the qualified rule.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency) are still outstanding.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success: update them to match current site stats.
